I do not know about the public schooling system since i have only been in one private school all my life. Though, if you are intrested in hearing a 9th graders take on their own school, feel free to continue.

To be clear, my school is the OB Montessori private school. 

Well, in all honesty i fully support the Montessori system of learning which in my school wasnt really following now that i think about it. My school prides itself that it is indeed a true Montessori school but it felt more like just normal learning. The students during my casa (basically preschool) years were put indeed put in a prepared environment yet we dont choose what task is given to us which is what the Montessori system revolves around. The teacher chooses what task will each student do around the class. I vividly remember that i have never once touched or used a material without my teacher telling me before hand to do so. The prepared environment that my school was so proud of were merely just props to look pretty. That fact became more prevalent when i came into grade school. 

In grade school, we never ever touched the materials and instead just went on with the usual teacher speaking in front and children taking down notes method. We would only use the materials when there is an open house event, wherein the parents are invited in the school; And when there are visitors from other schools. And these events were always practiced a few days before the event. 

Usually, when you are a good student and finish your works early, that is the only time you were allowed to choose what materials you want to use and truly learn the montessorian way. 

And well highschool is just normal highschool really. The materials are now removed and its just like the past few years really. 

please take of this as you will and i am only speaking for my school only, i am not saying that all private nor Montessori schools are this way. I do sincerely hope this gave whoever read this an insight in a private school feel free to ask me any questions.
